description: A wire rack sits on the right side of the counter holding several colorful plastic cups (red, green, and blue), with open space on the counter in front. The right hand reaches in from the right, lifts a yellow cup out of the rack and sets it upright on the counter, then removes a red cup and places it beside the yellow one, and finally picks up a blue cup and sets it down near the other two while leaving the remaining cups in the rack.
